checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/dop-protocol and extract exact in-scope contracts, repos, deployment addresses, and excluded contracts.
Clone the confirmed DOP Protocol Solidity repo and note all production contract paths.
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py --target <repo-root> --mode full to execute recon, Slither, Aderyn, and Mythril.
Invoke Halmos symbolic execution via the same script on high-value functions (deposit, withdraw, claim, upgrade).
Manually review access-control patterns, proxy admin roles, and any role-based modifiers in the generated report.
Check for reentrancy, oracle trust assumptions, and business-logic flaws in token accounting or reward distribution.
Validate any findings against live contract bytecode on Ethereum mainnet using the reported addresses.
Draft submission with contract address, exact vulnerable lines, minimal PoC, and impact per HackenProof template.
Verify the current scope, rules, and payout tiers for the DOP Protocol bug bounty program directly on the Hackenproof website to ensure accuracy and avoid any potential misunderstandings.
Identify the specific Solidity/EVM smart contracts that are in scope for the DOP Protocol program, as listed on the program's Hackenproof page or provided through additional program documentation.

Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py on the identified in-scope smart contracts to perform an initial analysis using Slither, Halmos symbolic execution, Mythril, Aderyn static AST analysis, and frontier-LLM review.

Analyze the output from agents/deep_dive_audit.py to identify potential vulnerabilities and areas that require further manual review, focusing on common issues such as access control, oracle trust, reentrancy, and business logic flaws.

Manually review the smart contracts against a real vulnerability taxonomy, checking for issues like unauthorized access, sensitive data exposure, and potential attack vectors that may not have been caught by automated tools.
Investigate any potential vulnerabilities identified during the analysis and review phases to determine their validity and potential impact on the DOP Protocol.

Document all findings, including potential vulnerabilities, in a clear and concise manner, ensuring that each issue is thoroughly described and includes any relevant code snippets, exploit examples, or other supporting evidence.

Prepare a submission for the Hackenproof bug bounty platform, following the program's guidelines for reporting vulnerabilities and including all necessary details and supporting documentation for the identified issues.

Submit the report to the DOP Protocol bug bounty program through the Hackenproof platform, ensuring that all required information is included and that the submission is made within any applicable deadlines or timeframes.
Identify the specific Solidity/EVM smart contracts that are within the scope of the DOP Protocol bug bounty program to determine the target for the audit.

Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py on the identified smart contracts to perform a comprehensive analysis using tools such as Slither, Halmos symbolic execution, Mythril, Aderyn static AST analysis, and frontier-LLM review.
Analyze the results from agents/deep_dive_audit.py to identify potential vulnerabilities, focusing on common issues such as access control, oracle trust, reentrancy, and business logic flaws.
Manually review the contracts and analysis results to validate the findings, check for false positives, and identify any potential vulnerabilities that may have been missed by the automated tools.
Categorize and prioritize the identified vulnerabilities based on their severity and potential impact, using a real vulnerability taxonomy to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Prepare a detailed report of the findings, including descriptions of the vulnerabilities, steps to reproduce, and recommendations for remediation, to submit to the DOP Protocol bug bounty program.
Ensure the report meets the submission requirements outlined in the program's rules, including any specific formatting or content guidelines, to guarantee a successful submission.
Submit the report to the DOP Protocol bug bounty program through the Hackenproof platform, following the program's instructions for submission and awaiting feedback and potential reward.
